_note: Moments destroyed per edition, from Atlas (Dapper Labs' catalogue): the chain never decrements an edition's count, so this is the only source of a remaining supply. Key setID_playID; value the burned count when every destroyed moment was Standard, else { subeditionID: n } per subedition (0 = Standard), the edition count being their sum. Editions with nothing burned are absent. Refresh with `npm run atlas:harvest` then `npm run atlas:burns`.
